patterns.note: Full-bleed hero image with a dark overlay, followed by a single, centered content column on a contrasting background.
Headings use an elegant serif font, while body text and form labels use a clean, legible sans-serif.
A high-contrast monochrome palette of black, white, and light grey is used throughout, creating a professional and serious tone.
The cookie consent banner remains fixed to the bottom-right of the viewport as the user scrolls.

technique_notes: Full-bleed hero image with a semi-transparent dark overlay for text legibility. The overlay is a solid color, not a gradient.
Content sections are presented as single, centered blocks with a distinct background color from the hero.
A sticky element (cookie banner) is positioned absolutely to the viewport, maintaining its position during scroll.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, elegant serif headings (~3x body) are paired with smaller, clean sans-serif body text and uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle; form fields and buttons have very slightly rounded corners, almost sharp.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced; the hero is airy, while the contact form has standard, comfortable spacing between elements.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a conceptual, networked people graphic in the hero, combined with a formal serif typeface, immediately communicates a focus on executive development and interconnectedness, setting a serious and authoritative tone.
